text:
incident-bot: AUTO-ALERT 2751113344 - routing.smart-route-v2 detected rapid region health oscillation. Observed sustained cross-region churn: us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Possible cascading fallback loops. Severity: open P1 if error rate > 1%.

Maya Patel: paging in — oncall here. I'm seeing a small but steady stream of 5xx and long-tail retries. Dashboards show requests cycling across regions every ~25-35s.

Sam Ortiz: seeing the same. spike in 502/504s starting +00:03. routing logs show many decisions to failover to next region within same request window. looks like health-checks flapping.

Leo Chen: quick scan of model-serving logs in eu shows intermittent "model not found" and variant mismatch errors at the same timestamps as health flips. suspect model-variant sync lag triggers immediate fallback.

Priya Singh: impact check: 3 paying customers (mid-market) saw ~1.8% request failures during the worst minute. CS: I've started triage msgs via cs-urgency channel to top accounts.

Maya Patel: immediate mitigation idea — disable cross-region fallback for smart-route-v2 so we stop cycling traffic across regions while we stabilize. Anyone object?

Sam Ortiz: no objection. executing toggle now.

Sam Ortiz: running patch: 
PATCH /api/admin/routing/policies/smart-route-v2
payload:
{"cross_region_fallback": false, "min_healthy_percent": 60}
Applying...

Sam Ortiz: 200 OK — cross_region_fallback disabled, change committed by sam.ortiz at 2751113388.

incident-bot: config change recorded: routing.smart-route-v2 updated (actor: sam.ortiz).

Leo Chen: while fallback is disabled, I'll push a temporary variant pin for eu so any internal retries don't hit an incompatible model.

Leo Chen: commands applied:
kubectl -n models set env deploy/model-sync VARIANT_MAP="{'eu':'variant-a-quant'}"
kubectl -n models rollout restart deploy/model-sync
Result: rollout started at 2751113421.

Priya Singh: CS update: templated notification drafted and sent to the three impacted customers. ETA for a more detailed post-incident note: 2 hours. No outage-level SLA breach expected but we're tracking.

Maya Patel: monitoring graphs — inter-region handoffs dropped to near-zero within 45s of the toggle. tail latencies improving.

Sam Ortiz: recommending follow-ups (action items):
- add compatibility gate in fallback logic to block fallback if model variant mismatch detected
- add debounce to region health-check state transitions (e.g., require 3 consecutive failures before failover)
- raise model-sync propagation priority for canary/variant metadata

Leo Chen: quick policy guard prototype (to be reviewed by eng-runtime):
```python
# pseudo
if fallback_region.variant != current_region.variant:
    block_fallback()
else:
    allow_fallback()
```
We should also log detailed reasons for any blocked fallback.

Maya Patel: leaving the incident in a monitored state; handing off to oncall-ops for the next 2h to watch for regressions and collect traces for RCA. oncall-ops, you own the postmortem.

oncall-ops: ack. I'll collect traces, timeline, and the variant sync logs. Creating internal incident doc under /incidents/2751113344. Will coordinate with eng-runtime and eng-platform for code changes.

Priya Singh: customer-impact summary for the doc: window: ~12 minutes, peak failure rate 1.8%, affected requests ~4k, customers contacted (3), no immediate billing adjustments requested.

Maya Patel: quick retrospective notes added to runbook: quick-toggle path to turn off cross-region fallback, and checklist to verify variant parity before enabling fallback. tagging eng-runtime, eng-platform, devex. :white_check_mark:

Sam Ortiz: leaving logs/links: 
- graph: https://console.redwood.ai/graphs/2751113344
- routing diff: https://console.redwood.ai/configs/smart-route-v2/diff/2751113388
- model-sync rollout: https://k8s.redwood.ai/rollouts/model-sync/2751113421

Leo Chen: follow-up owner for variant-gate PR: leo.chen. I'll put up a draft today.

Maya Patel: thanks team — closing active mitigation. if we see any repeat oscillation we reopen. :rocket:

cs-urgency: Noted. I'll follow up with customers with the final postmortem once it's ready.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 2751113344 status: mitigated -> monitoring. committed actions: disable_cross_region_fallback, pin_variant_eu, model-sync-rollout.

Maya Patel: end of thread — handoff complete.
